capture_jobs.description: 官方 Codex HTTP／WS 的 direct 与 MITM 核心矩阵；若异步 /models 被客户端取消，使用容器内同一冷 HOME/CODEX_HOME 的官方 app-server 仅执行 initialize，保持启动刷新 worker 存活且不创建 thread/turn，并等待独立临时 MITM 根刷盘目标模型 HTTP 200 后原子安装唯一制品

argv:
set -Eeuo pipefail
run_root={capture_root}/runs/official-client/oauth/oauth-{campaign_id}
output_dir=$run_root/mitm/codex-http/s1
models_file=$output_dir/models-http.jsonl
scratch_root=/tmp/codex-model-mitm-{campaign_id}
staged_models_file=$output_dir/.models-http.jsonl.r14-{campaign_id}
scratch_created=0
staged_created=0
mitm_pid=
cleanup() {{
  set +e
  if test -n "$mitm_pid"; then
    kill -TERM "$mitm_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    wait "$mitm_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  if test "$staged_created" -eq 1; then
    rm -f -- "$staged_models_file"
  fi
  if test "$scratch_created" -eq 1; then
    rm -rf -- "$scratch_root"
  fi
}}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
test -d "$output_dir"
if test -e "$models_file"; then
  test -f "$models_file"
  test ! -L "$models_file"
fi
if test ! -s "$models_file"; then
  test ! -e "$models_file"
  test ! -e "$scratch_root"
  test ! -e "$staged_models_file"
  install -d -m 0700 "$scratch_root"
  scratch_created=1
  driver_status=1
  candidate_models_file=
  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    attempt_root=$scratch_root/attempt-$attempt
    home=$attempt_root/home
    relay=$attempt_root/relay
    candidate_output_dir=$attempt_root/mitm
    candidate_models_file=$candidate_output_dir/models-http.jsonl
    prewarm=$attempt_root/model-catalog-prewarm.json
    mitmdump_log=$attempt_root/model-prewarm-mitmdump.log
    driver_log=$attempt_root/model-prewarm-driver.log
    install -d -m 0700 "$home" "$relay" "$candidate_output_dir"
    install -m 0600 /root/.codex/auth.json "$home/auth.json"
    env \
      CAPTURE_TASK=oauth \
      CAPTURE_BOUNDARY=official_cli_to_official_platform \
      CAPTURE_RUN_ID=oauth-{campaign_id} \
      CAPTURE_SUBJECT=codex-http \
      CAPTURE_SCENARIO=s1 \
      CAPTURE_TARGET_HOSTS=chatgpt.com \
      CAPTURE_HOST_SCOPE=targets \
      CAPTURE_OUTPUT_DIR="$candidate_output_dir" \
      /usr/bin/mitmdump \
        --listen-host 127.0.0.1 \
        --listen-port 18080 \
        --set confdir=/opt/mitm \
        --set block_global=false \
        -s {repo_root}/tools/official_client_capture/addons/mitm_capture.py \
        >"$mitmdump_log" 2>&1 &
    mitm_pid=$!
    ready=0
    for unused in $(seq 1 100); do
      if python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',18080),0.1); s.close()" 2>/dev/null; then
        ready=1
        break
      fi
      kill -0 "$mitm_pid"
      sleep 0.05
    done
    test "$ready" -eq 1
    set +e
    env \
      HOME="$home" \
      CODEX_HOME="$home" \
      HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:18080" \
      HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:18080" \
      http_proxy="http://127.0.0.1:18080" \
      https_proxy="http://127.0.0.1:18080" \
      SSL_CERT_FILE=/opt/mitm/mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem \
      timeout 30 python3 {repo_root}/tools/official_client_capture/drive_codex_model_catalog.py \
        --codex-bin {capture_codex_bin} \
        --codex-version {target_version} \
        --model {model} \
        --expect-use-responses-lite false \
        --mitm-models-http "$candidate_models_file" \
        --relay-dir "$relay" \
        --output "$prewarm" \
        --timeout 20 \
        >>"$driver_log" 2>&1
    driver_status=$?
    set -e
    printf 'attempt=%s initialize_driver_status=%s\n' "$attempt" "$driver_status" >>"$driver_log"
    kill -TERM "$mitm_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    wait "$mitm_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    mitm_pid=
    if test "$driver_status" -eq 0; then
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  test "$driver_status" -eq 0
  test -s "$candidate_models_file"
  test -f "$candidate_models_file"
  test ! -L "$candidate_models_file"
  candidate_sha256=$(sha256sum "$candidate_models_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  test ! -e "$models_file"
  install -m 0600 "$candidate_models_file" "$staged_models_file"
  staged_created=1
  staged_sha256=$(sha256sum "$staged_models_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  test "$candidate_sha256" = "$staged_sha256"
  test ! -e "$models_file"
  mv -n -- "$staged_models_file" "$models_file"
  test ! -e "$staged_models_file"
  staged_created=0
  installed_sha256=$(sha256sum "$models_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  test "$candidate_sha256" = "$installed_sha256"
fi
python3 - "$models_file" {model} <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib
import sys
path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
model = sys.argv[2]
valid = 0
for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
    record = json.loads(line)
    request = record.get("request") or dict()
    response = record.get("response") or dict()
    body = response.get("body") or dict()
    payload = body.get("json") or dict()
    models = payload.get("models") or list()
    if (
        request.get("method") == "GET"
        and str(request.get("path", "")).split("?", 1)[0] == "/backend-api/codex/models"
        and response.get("status") == 200
        and any(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("slug") == model for item in models)
    ):
        valid += 1
if valid < 1:
    raise SystemExit("initialize 模型目录补采没有形成目标模型的完整 HTTP 200")
print("validated_models_http_200=" + str(valid))
PY
python3 - "$run_root" {repo_root} <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib
import sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
repo = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo))
from tools.official_client_capture.capturelib.analysis import normalize_mitm_directory
from tools.official_client_capture.capturelib.security import inventory_artifacts, scan_for_secrets, secure_write_json
normalize_mitm_directory(
    root / "mitm" / "codex-http" / "s1",
    root / "analysis" / "mitm" / "codex-http" / "s1.json",
)
manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if manifest.get("status") != "complete":
    raise SystemExit("official-core manifest 不是 complete，拒绝补采收口")
manifest["secret_scan"] = scan_for_secrets(root, dict())
manifest["artifacts"] = inventory_artifacts(root)
secure_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
print("official_core_artifacts=" + str(len(manifest["artifacts"])))
PY

argv:
set -Eeuo pipefail
run_root={capture_root}/runs/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe
runtime_root={capture_root}/runtime/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe
test ! -e "$run_root"
install -d -m 0700 "$run_root" "$runtime_root"
cleanup() {{ rm -f -- "$runtime_root/request.bin" "$runtime_root/ca.key" "$runtime_root/ca.crt" "$runtime_root/ca.srl" "$runtime_root/server.key" "$runtime_root/server.csr" "$runtime_root/server.ext" "$runtime_root/server.crt"; rmdir -- "$runtime_root" 2>/dev/null || true; }}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 1 -subj /CN=Codex-Wham-Probe-CA -addext basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE -addext keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign -keyout "$runtime_root/ca.key" -out "$runtime_root/ca.crt"
openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj /CN=chatgpt.com -keyout "$runtime_root/server.key" -out "$runtime_root/server.csr"
printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:chatgpt.com\nbasicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n' > "$runtime_root/server.ext"
openssl x509 -req -in "$runtime_root/server.csr" -CA "$runtime_root/ca.crt" -CAkey "$runtime_root/ca.key" -CAcreateserial -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$runtime_root/server.ext" -out "$runtime_root/server.crt"
chmod 0600 "$runtime_root"/*
docker run --rm --network none --add-host chatgpt.com:127.0.0.1 --cap-drop ALL --cap-add NET_BIND_SERVICE --security-opt no-new-privileges --entrypoint python3 -v {capture_root}:/capture -v {repo_root}:{repo_root}:ro -v {relay_codex_bin}:/usr/local/bin/codex:ro -e SSL_CERT_FILE=/capture/runtime/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe/ca.crt {runtime_image} {repo_root}/tools/official_client_capture/drive_codex_wham_consume.py --codex-bin /usr/local/bin/codex --codex-version {target_version} --cert /capture/runtime/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe/server.crt --key /capture/runtime/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe/server.key --output /capture/runtime/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe/request.bin --metadata /capture/runs/{campaign_id}-official-wham-safe/metadata.json
